🌱 I TAKE CARE OF MY HEALTH WITH THE GUIDANCE OF MY FAMILY

⭐ What Does It Mean to Take Care of Our Health?

Taking care of our health is an important habit that we should develop as we grow.

Being healthy helps us have a strong body and mind and protects us from sickness.

Our family, especially our parents, can guide and help us learn healthy habits.

💪 WHY SHOULD WE TAKE CARE OF OUR HEALTH?

There are six important reasons mentioned in the lesson:

1. ⚡ Stay Super Energetic

Eating healthy food and exercising regularly give our body energy.

➡️ We feel ready to play, learn, and do activities.

2. 🛡️ Be Strong Against Sickness

Taking care of our health helps protect us from germs that can make us sick.

➡️ A healthy body becomes like a strong shield.

3. 🧠 Think Like a Genius

Eating well and staying active help our brain work better.

➡️ This helps us learn new things and do well in school.

4. 😊 Become Happy

Exercising and eating colorful, healthy food can help us feel happy.

➡️ Being healthy can give us more smiles, giggles, and happy moments.

5. 🏃 Have a Lot of Fun

When we are healthy, we have more energy to play.

➡️ We can run, jump, and enjoy playtime with our friends.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 HOW CAN I STAY HEALTHY WITH MY FAMILY?

The lesson gives several ways we can practice healthy habits together with our family:

🥦 1. Eat Nutritious Food

  • Eat more fruits and vegetables.
  • Try different healthy foods with your parents.
  • Have a family cooking day and prepare nutritious meals together.

⭐ REMEMBER: Choose healthy and nutritious food instead of unhealthy snacks.

⚽ 2. Have Active Family Playtime

Do physical activities together, such as:

  • Walking
  • Riding bicycles
  • Playing games
  • Running and other active activities

⭐ Exercise can also be a fun family bonding activity.

😴 3. Get Enough Sleep

  • Have a bedtime routine.
  • Follow a regular sleep schedule.
  • Relax before bedtime by reading, talking with family, or listening to soothing music.

⭐ REMEMBER: Enough sleep is important for a healthy body and mind.

💧 4. Drink Plenty of Water

Drink plenty of water every day.

Water helps keep your body healthy and happy.

⭐ REMEMBER: Water is important for good health.

🪥 5. Practice Healthy Habits

You can make a healthy-habit chart with your parents.

Examples:

  • Brush your teeth
  • Wash your hands
  • Eat fruits and vegetables

You can use stickers to track your healthy habits.

🌳 6. Enjoy Outdoor Adventures

Go outdoors with your family.

You can explore:

  • Parks
  • Nature trails
  • Your backyard

Outdoor activities allow you to move your body and discover your surroundings.

💬 7. Talk About Health With Your Family

Have open and friendly discussions with your parents about staying healthy.

➡️ Share your thoughts and listen to your family members.

🍎 HEALTHY VS. UNHEALTHY CHOICES

✅ HEALTHY CHOICES

  • 🍎 Eating fruits
  • 🥦 Eating vegetables
  • 💧 Drinking plenty of water
  • 🏃 Doing physical exercises
  • 😴 Getting enough sleep
  • 🪥 Taking care of personal hygiene
  • 🌳 Playing outdoors

The lesson specifically identifies eating fruits, drinking plenty of water, and doing simple physical exercises as good ways to stay healthy.

❌ UNHEALTHY CHOICES

  • 🥤 Drinking soft drinks
  • 🍟 Eating too much junk food
  • 📱 Staying up late playing with mobile devices

⭐ IMPORTANT: Avoid unhealthy food and habits that can harm your health.

🧠 SUPER EASY MEMORY GUIDE

Remember these 5 important things:

🍎 EAT WELL

Choose nutritious food.

💧 DRINK WATER

Drink plenty of water.

🏃 MOVE

Exercise and play actively.

😴 SLEEP

Get a good night's sleep.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 DO IT WITH FAMILY

Work together with your family to stay healthy.

The lesson summarizes that staying healthy requires nutritious food, family activities, enough sleep, and discussing and planning healthy habits together.

🌟 KEY IDEAS TO REMEMBER

⭐ Being healthy gives you a strong body and mind.

⭐ It is important to grow healthy with your family members.

⭐ A healthy body protects you from sickness.

📌 ONE-SENTENCE SUMMARY

I can take care of my health by eating nutritious food, drinking plenty of water, exercising, getting enough sleep

g2_q1c2l1.sub: Five Important Reasons to Take Care of One's Health
g2_q1c2l1.title: Self-Care and Staying Healthy

🌈 I UNDERSTAND MY OWN EMOTIONS

💡 What are Emotions?

Emotions are the feelings we have when something happens to us.

For example:

  • We feel happy when we play with our favorite toy.
  • We feel sad when we lose something we love.
  • We feel scared when something makes us worried.

👉 Remember: Everyone experiences different emotions, and it is okay to have different feelings.

😊 Different Kinds of Emotions

1. 😊 HAPPY

You feel happy when you are having fun or something good happens.

You may: smile, laugh, or want to dance.

2. 😢 SAD

You feel sad when you are upset or something makes you unhappy.

You may: cry or want to be alone.

👉 It is okay to feel sad. Talking to someone you trust can help.

3. 😡 ANGRY

You feel angry when something frustrates or upsets you.

You may: want to shout or stomp your feet.

👉 When angry, calm yourself first by taking deep breaths or talking about what made you upset.

4. 😨 SCARED

You feel scared when you are afraid or worried.

You may: hide, ask for help, or have a fast heartbeat.

👉 It is okay to feel scared. You can talk to someone about it.

5. 😲 SURPRISED

You feel surprised when something unexpected happens.

You may: open your eyes wide or drop your mouth open.

6. 🤪 SILLY

You feel silly when you are being playful and funny.

You may: giggle or make funny faces.

7. 😕 CONFUSED

You feel confused when you are unsure or puzzled.

You may: ask many questions to understand.

8. 🤒 SICK

You feel sick when your body does not feel well.

You may: have a headache, tummy ache, or feel tired.

👉 When sick, rest and drink water.

9. 🥰 PROUD

You feel proud when you are happy about something you did or accomplished.

10. 😊 SHY

You feel shy when you are nervous or timid, especially around new people or situations.

👉 It is okay to feel shy. Take your time to become comfortable.

11. 😟 STRESSED

You feel stressed when you are worried or overwhelmed.

You may: feel tense or have trouble sleeping.

👉 Take deep breaths and talk to someone about how you feel.

⭐ Why Is It Important to Understand Our Emotions?

Knowing our emotions is not enough. We also need to express our feelings properly.

When emotions are not controlled, they can lead to actions that may:

  • hurt other people
  • offend or disrespect others

But when we learn to control our emotions, we develop SELF-DISCIPLINE and RESPECT for other people, especially our family and friends.

🧘 How Can I Manage My Emotions?

When you have a BIG FEELING, try these:

🌬️ 1. TAKE DEEP BREATHS

Breathe slowly and deeply to help yourself calm down.

🗣️ 2. USE WORDS TO SHARE

Tell someone you trust, such as a family member or friend, how you feel.

🔢 3. COUNT TO THREE

When you feel a strong emotion, count slowly to three. This gives you time to think before reacting.

🤫 4. FIND A QUIET SPACE

Go somewhere peaceful where you can relax and calm down.

🤗 5. ASK FOR A HUG OR COMFORT

If you need comfort, you can ask a family member or very close friend for a hug.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: Always ask permission before getting a hug, and never ask a stranger for a hug.

🧠 VERY IMPORTANT TO REMEMBER

EMOTIONS → FEELINGS → ACTIONS

We cannot always choose what we feel, but we can learn to choose how we respond to our feelings.

🌟 The most important lessons:

  • Everyone has different emotions.
  • It is okay to feel different emotions.
  • We should express our feelings properly.
  • Uncontrolled emotions can hurt or offend others.
  • Controlling our emotions helps develop self-discipline.
  • Self-discipline helps us show respect to family and friends.
  • When emotions are strong, STOP, CALM DOWN, and THINK before reacting.

📚 Quick Memory Guide

5 WAYS TO MANAGE EMOTIONS:

🌬️ Breathe deeply
🗣️ Words — tell someone you trust
🔢 Count to three
🤫 Q Quiet space
🤗 Ask for comfort

Remember: Feel it → Calm down → Think → Respond properly.

🙏 I PRAY TO GOD FOR MYSELF AND OTHERS

💡 What is Prayer?

Prayer is our personal communication with God.

When we pray, we can:

  • Talk to God about our feelings, experiences, hopes, and worries.
  • Thank God for the good things in our lives.
  • Praise and show our love for God.
  • Ask God for help and guidance.

👉 IMPORTANT: Prayer helps us build a stronger relationship with God because it is a way of communicating with Him.

🌟 Benefits of Praying

Prayer gives us many good things:

❤️ 1. Strengthens Our Friendship with God

When we pray and talk to God, we become closer to Him.

🙏 2. Makes Our Heart Thankful

We can use prayer to thank God for our blessings, such as our family, friends, food, and other good things.

💪 3. Gives Us More Courage

Prayer can give us strength and courage when we face something difficult or scary.

🧭 4. Guides Us in Making Good Choices

Prayer can help us choose what is right and do good things, such as helping someone who needs us.

🛡️ 5. Makes Us Feel Loved and Protected

Prayer helps us remember that God loves us and cares for us.

🙌 Different Ways to Pray

There are many ways to have a personal prayer.

👤 1. Praying Individually

This means talking to God one-on-one.

You can tell God about:

  • your day
  • your feelings
  • your dreams
  • your worries

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 2. Praying with Your Community

People can pray together as a group.

They may:

  • pray together
  • sing songs
  • share their love for God

🌳 3. Praying with Nature

You can pray while appreciating God's wonderful creations.

Nature can remind us that God cares for all creation, including us.

📖 4. Praying through Devotions

Devotions are special stories, songs, and prayers that help us learn more about God's love.

🤫 5. Praying Quietly / Quiet Reflection

Sometimes we can simply sit quietly and think about God's love and blessings.

👉 IMPORTANT: Prayer can be expressed through words, songs, or silence.

❤️ Praying for Others

Prayer is not only about ourselves. We can also pray for our family, friends, community, and other people who need help.

We can pray for:

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Our family
  • 👫 Our friends
  • 🏘️ Our community
  • 🤝 People who help us
  • ❤️ People who need our prayers

The lesson encourages us to create a personal prayer for the people in our family and community.

⭐ VERY IMPORTANT TO REMEMBER

🙏 PRAYER = COMMUNICATION WITH GOD

When we pray, we can:

❤️ Love God
🙏 Praise God
🙌 Thank God
💬 Talk to God
💪 Ask for strength and courage
🧭 Ask for guidance
❤️ Pray for ourselves and others

🌈 Easy Memory Sentence:

“I pray to God to talk to Him, thank Him, ask for guidance, and show my love for Him and others.”

Remember: Prayer keeps our relationship with God strong. 🙏❤️
